pkgmetadata.longdescription:
pwnagotchi drives bettercap over its REST and websocket API to collect WPA handshake material from the air, showing status on a small e-paper or LCD panel. This is the jayofelony fork, whose default branch (noai) drops the deep reinforcement learning agent of the original; the remaining auto-tune plugin still adapts the personality parameters from per-session channel and AP histograms, so the device does still adjust to its environment.
Upstream ships this as a whole Raspberry Pi OS image rather than a package. Only the Python application is packaged here: bettercap and pwngrid are separate Go daemons and are not in Portage, and the image-only shell scaffolding (pwnlib, pwnagotchi-launcher, bettercap-launcher) is replaced by a service file and driver-agnostic monitor-mode helpers.
Capturing handshakes from networks you do not own or have written permission to test is illegal in most jurisdictions. The default personality performs deauthentication and association attacks.
